summary: Implemented the progress file-reading feature in rich/progress.py (private _FileReader and _ReaderContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file), added 14 tests to tests/test_progress.py, added two docs subsections to docs/source/progress.rst, and added a changelog bullet for PR 1759. All changes are additions; nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and repo code were not run, per instructions. Known risks: the module-level open passes a str mode into Progress.open's Literal overloads, which mypy will likely flag without a suppression; the buffering-forwarding test for values above 1 is not covered. Also added mode and name properties on the reader for Python 3.6 ABC compatibility, which the spec did not list.
